mapper.sql: d.task_id, d.conversation_id, d.source_message_id, d.card_message_id, d.title, d.workflow_state, CASE WHEN d.workflow_state IN ('completed', 'rejected', 'cancelled') THEN d.workflow_state WHEN d.overdue_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'overdue' ELSE d.workflow_state END AS status, CASE WHEN d.overdue_at IS NOT NULL AND d.workflow_state NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, d.priority, d.dept_id, dept.dept_name, d.deadline_at, d.acceptance_standard, CAST(d.reminder_config_json AS CHAR) AS reminder_config_json, d.customer_id, d.business_type, d.business_id, d.creator_id, COALESCE(creator_emp.name, creator.nickname, creator.username, '已离职员工') AS creator_name, d.reviewer_id, COALESCE(reviewer_emp.name, reviewer.nickname, reviewer.username, '已离职员工') AS reviewer_name, d.result_text, d.reject_reason, d.accepted_at, d.submitted_at, d.completed_at, d.cancelled_at, d.overdue_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at

FROM im_task_detail d JOIN biz_task b ON b.id = d.task_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.id = d.dept_id AND dept.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.id = d.creator_id AND creator.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_employee creator_emp ON creator_emp.user_id = d.creator_id AND creator_emp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.id = d.reviewer_id AND reviewer.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_employee reviewer_emp ON reviewer_emp.user_id = d.reviewer_id AND reviewer_emp.deleted = 0

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_task_participant p WHERE p.company_id = d.company_id AND p.task_id = d.task_id AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.participant_role = 'responsible' )

mapper.select: SELECT p.task_id, p.user_id, COALESCE(e.name, u.nickname, u.username, '已离职员工') AS name, COALESCE(e.avatar, u.avatar) AS avatar, COALESCE(e.dept_id, u.dept_id) AS dept_id, dept.dept_name, p.participant_role AS role, p.participant_status AS status FROM im_task_participant p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_employee e ON e.user_id = p.user_id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.id = COALESCE(e.dept_id, u.dept_id) AND dept.deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.company_id = #{tenantId} AND p.task_id IN #{taskId} ORDER BY FIELD(p.participant_role, 'responsible', 'collaborator'), p.id

SELECT t.id, t.operator_id, COALESCE(e.name, u.nickname, u.username, CASE WHEN t.operator_id = 0 THEN '系统' ELSE '已离职员工' END) AS operator_name, t.action_type, t.from_state, t.to_state, t.comment, t.created_at FROM im_task_timeline t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.operator_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_employee e ON e.user_id = t.operator_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.company_id = #{tenantId} AND t.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.message_id, a.original_name, a.mime_type, a.file_size, CASE WHEN a.mime_type LIKE 'image/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS image, CONCAT('/im/attachments/', a.id, '/inline') AS preview_url, CONCAT('/im/attachments/', a.id, '/download') AS download_url, CASE WHEN a.thumbnail_key IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('/im/attachments/', a.id, '/thumbnail') END AS thumbnail_url, a.created_at FROM im_task_attachment ta JOIN im_message_attachment a ON a.id = ta.attachment_id WHERE ta.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ta.company_id = #{tenantId} AND ta.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ta.created_at ASC, ta.id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.workflow_state = 'pending_accept' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_accept, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.workflow_state = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_progress, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.workflow_state = 'pending_review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_review, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.workflow_state = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.workflow_state = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.overdue_at IS NOT NULL AND d.workflow_state NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue FROM im_task_detail d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.company_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND (r.role_key = 'dept_manager' OR LEFT(r.role_key, CHAR_LENGTH('dept_manager') + 2) = CONCAT('dept_manager', '__'))

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 AND
(
(r.role_key = #{roleKey} OR (#{roleKey} NOT IN ('boss', 'admin', 'super_admin', 'sys_admin') AND LEFT(r.role_key, CHAR_LENGTH(#{roleKey}) + 2) = CONCAT(#{roleKey}, '__')))
)
1 = 0
ORDER BY u.id
mapper.update: UPDATE im_task_reminder r JOIN im_notification_outbox o ON o.company_id = r.company_id AND o.event_id = r.event_id SET r.status = 'sent', r.sent_at = COALESCE(r.sent_at, o.processed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), r.last_error = NULL, r.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE r.status IN ('pending', 'queued', 'failed') AND o.status = 'sent'

UPDATE im_task_reminder r JOIN im_notification_outbox o ON o.company_id = r.company_id AND o.event_id = r.event_id SET r.status = 'failed', r.last_error = LEFT(o.last_error, 500), r.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE r.status IN ('pending', 'queued') AND o.status = 'dead'
